title: On variation functions of lacunary series
summary: We study variation functions of some lacunary series along the sequence of $b$-adic partitions, where $b>1$ is an integer. By such a lacunary series, we mean that in the definition of the well-known Weierstrass function, the Lipschitz continuous cosine and sine functions are replaced by a continuous and piecewise continuously differentiable periodic function whose Fourier series has zero $(jb)^{\mathrm{th}}$-Fourier coefficients for all non-zero integers $j$.
